ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) has announced its scheduled participation in a "BNPP India Consumer Field Trip" on November 26, 2026, where company representatives will physically meet with multiple investors and analysts in Mumbai. Discussions will be based on the previously submitted Q2H1FY27 earnings presentation, with the company explicitly stating no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be shared. This is a standard regulatory disclosure of investor engagement, indicating routine corporate transparency without presenting new material financial impacts or immediate red flags.
